about: C5: text that doesn't count as saying a fact again. key is going, live, time or place (the event page) or distance (route preview and Settings); text is a regex removed from the line before counting.

allow.why: The count of people going ("11 going · 8 cars, 3 bikes"), not your own status.
The location line ("Location shows at 21:30 to people going."), 4.11 wording.
The primary before you say you're going.
When a chat message was sent, not the meet's time.
